import_export.keep_desc: In Google Takeout, select only Keep and download the zip. Text, checklists, images, drawings, labels, colors, pins, archive, links, and dates come across.
import_export.markdown_desc: A zip of Markdown or text files, or a single file: Obsidian, Joplin, Blinko's Markdown export, a NoteTrace export, or any app that exports Markdown. Titles, tags, dates, and images in the zip are kept.
import_export.evernote_desc: An .enex export, or a zip of several. In Evernote, export a notebook or selected notes as ENEX. Text, formatting, checklists, images, tags, dates, and upcoming reminders come across.
import_export.label_notebook: Label notes with their notebook name
import_export.no_evernote_notes: No Evernote notes found in that file
import_export.memos_desc: Reads your memos straight from your Memos server. In Memos' settings, create a personal access token. Content, tags, images, pins, archive, and dates come across. The token isn't saved.

import_export.no_memos_notes: No memos found for that account
import_export.blinko_desc: A backup (.bko) file from an older Blinko version; current Blinko no longer creates them, so use its Markdown export with Markdown Files below. Notes, images, tags, pins, archive, and dates come across, from the Blinko account that matches your username.

cooking.show_shared: Show Shared Recipes in My Main List
cooking.url_engine_desc_standard_html: Standard reads the page's schema.org/Recipe data. Free and fast; works on most major recipe sites.
cooking.url_engine_desc_enhanced_html: Enhanced runs recipe-scrapers, which has site-specific extractors for ~300 popular sites and falls back to schema.org on everything else.
cooking.url_engine_desc_smart_html: Smart hands the page to your Trace AI. Slower and uses your AI quota, but recovers recipes from sites that block scrapers or hide their content in non-standard markup.
cooking.smart_note: Smart sends every URL import to your AI, which uses your provider's quota on every paste. Standard or Enhanced are free and handle most sites; consider setting Smart only as a fallback.
cooking.enhanced_fallback_desc: When the server is unreachable or recipe-scrapers isn't installed, fall back to this.
